tool.name: CIRCexplorer
tool.description: annotate circular RNAs from fusion junction reads
tool.command: #if $input_selection.input_type == "star": star_parse.py '$input_selection.junc' ./fusion_junctions.txt && #end if ## CIRCexplorer calls pysam.faidx on the genome, which writes a .fai index next ## to the FASTA. Galaxy dataset files live on a read-only path, so link the ## genome into the working directory first. ln -s '$genome' ./genome.fa && CIRCexplorer.py #if $input_selection.input_type == "tophat": -f '$input_selection.fusion' #else: -j ./fusion_junctions.txt #end if -g ./genome.fa -r '$ref' $no_fix && mv ./CIRCexplorer_circ.txt '$output'

param.name: input_type
param.label: Source of fusion junction information
param.help: TopHat/TopHat-Fusion is unmaintained software, so STAR is the recommended mapping strategy

param.name: junc
param.label: STAR Chimeric junction file
param.help: Chimeric.out.junction file generated by STAR (requires STAR to be run with a non-zero --chimSegmentMin)

param.name: fusion
param.label: TopHat-Fusion fusion junction BAM
param.help: Fusion BAM file generated by TopHat/TopHat-Fusion

param.name: ref
param.label: Gene annotation
param.help: Gene annotation file in RefSeq-like format, as produced by the fetch_ucsc.py script shipped with CIRCexplorer

param.name: no_fix
param.label: Skip fixing of fusion junctions
param.help: This option is useful for species with poor gene annotations.

tool.help:
# CIRCexplorer
CIRCexplorer identifies junction reads from back-spliced exons and intron lariats, and is therefore able to identify and quantify circular RNAs (circRNAs and ciRNAs).
CIRCexplorer is a circular RNA *annotation* tool that parses fusion junction information from the results of other aligner mapping strategies. The annotation of circular RNAs depends on the aligner's own mapping strategy, so results may differ between aligners.
-----
## Input
- **Source of fusion junction information**: either a STAR `Chimeric.out.junction` file (generated when STAR is run with a non-zero `--chimSegmentMin`, converted internally with `star_parse.py`), or a TopHat-Fusion fusion junction BAM file. TopHat/TopHat-Fusion is unmaintained, so STAR is the recommended mapping strategy. - **Reference genome**: genome sequence in FASTA format. - **Gene annotation**: RefSeq-like gene annotation, e.g. as generated by the `fetch_ucsc.py` script shipped with CIRCexplorer.
-----
## Output
A tabular file with the annotated circular RNAs. The first 12 columns are BED12 (chrom, start, end, name, score, strand, thickStart, thickEnd, itemRgb, blockCount, blockSizes, blockStarts), followed by the number of junction reads, the circRNA/ciRNA type, the gene name, the isoform name, the exon/intron index and the flanking introns.
**Note:** CIRCexplorer2 and CIRCexplorer3 provide more advanced pipelines for circular RNA analysis; this tool wraps the original CIRCexplorer release.
